text: {"features":[{"name":"Production experience depth","description":"The depth of hands-on software-engineering experience the letter shows across testing, maintaining, and launching production systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows roughly minimum qualifying experience, such as around 3 years and only a small number of production services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows early-career experience with somewhat broader exposure, such as around 3 years with several services or around 5 years with only limited service breadth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid mid-level production experience, typically around 5 years or unusually broad exposure within a shorter tenure."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial experience across multiple launches and maintained systems, with clear evidence of dependable production responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows the strongest profile in the sample, combining long tenure, many production services, and visible progression into broader system ownership."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"The strength of the letter's evidence that Go is a serious, relevant language for the applicant's production work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only briefly or as one language among many, without showing depth or recent use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows Go as a regular language used in past work, but gives little detail about what was built with it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes clear that Go has been used meaningfully for production service development."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a primary language and ties it to backend services, infrastructure, or core systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes Go central to the case by pairing primary-language fluency with explicit design or implementation of important backend or control-plane systems."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"The extent to which the letter demonstrates practical, role-relevant Python experience.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or gives no usable evidence of practical experience with it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python only briefly or generically, without indicating scope, recency, or importance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for scripts, tooling, or automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows extensive Python use across services, automation, analysis, or internal tools."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows Python as a major production language, especially for automation layers, analysis tooling, or AI agents that other engineers depend on."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic reasoning","description":"The strength of evidence that the applicant uses data-structure and algorithmic thinking to improve systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no meaningful evidence of algorithmic thinking or data-structure work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims strength in algorithms or data structures but gives only vague or generic support."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one concrete example of using algorithms or data structures to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong, current algorithmic reasoning through a specific redesign that removed a bottleneck or simplified a system."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows unusually convincing algorithmic depth by describing sophisticated changes that materially improved performance, tractability, or correctness."}]},{"name":"Security assessment rigor","description":"The degree to which the letter shows hands-on, methodical security assessment experience.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security review in broad terms without methods, scope, or follow-through."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes performing security assessments with at least one concrete activity such as threat modeling, code review, or attack-surface analysis."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows hands-on assessment work across designs or production services and makes clear that findings were validated or remediated."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially mature assessment practice, describing structured methods, an attacker's perspective, and follow-through from finding to fix."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"The extent to which the letter demonstrates direct experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, or handling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says little or nothing about vulnerability handling or automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in automating security work but does not claim direct experience doing it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building some automation for vulnerability reports or security workflows, with limited detail on what it did."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes end-to-end automation of vulnerability intake or triage, including tasks such as classification, deduplication, routing, or ownership assignment."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong direct fit by describing robust vulnerability-handling automation that substantially reduced manual work and turned an ad hoc queue into a reliable pipeline."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems depth","description":"The strength of the letter's evidence that the applicant has designed or built agent-based systems with meaningful autonomy.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agents or autonomous workflows."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agentic tooling only loosely, without explaining architecture or responsibilities."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agent-based systems in general terms, usually with Python agents or Go services but limited detail on how they interact."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly explains an agentic architecture, including Python agents, Go services, and controls such as boundaries, permissions, or auditing."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially strong agentic-systems fit by presenting deliberate architecture, autonomy boundaries, and operational safeguards as a core part of past work."}]},{"name":"Applied AI maturity","description":"The degree to which the letter shows practical experience shipping and hardening AI or model-backed functionality.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of AI or model-based systems work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or exposure without saying the applicant shipped or operated it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States production experience with AI features or LLM-backed capabilities, but with limited operational detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes shipping AI functionality in production and addressing issues like evaluation, trustworthiness, unpredictable inputs, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows mature applied-AI experience by pairing shipped model-backed features with concrete practices for making them dependable in production."}]},{"name":"Security mission fit","description":"How well the letter shows informed motivation for secure-development, vulnerability-response, and security-automation work specifically.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives generic enthusiasm for the company or job title without showing understanding of the security mission."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some interest in security work, but the connection to secure development or vulnerability response remains broad."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects prior experience to security automation, secure development, or vulnerability handling in a reasonably direct way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains clearly why security engineering work of this kind is a logical next step and why the mission matters personally."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Offers a thoughtful security-engineering philosophy that closely matches secure-by-default, lifecycle-focused, automation-heavy work."}]},{"name":"Platform mindset","description":"The extent to which the letter conveys fit for foundational systems whose impact compounds across many teams or products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no real sign of interest in foundational or organization-wide infrastructure work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses general excitement about scale, but not about platform leverage specifically."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions broad impact, Google-scale systems, or foundational work at least once in a relevant way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly values central tools or infrastructure whose improvements help many teams downstream."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently frames past work and future goals around platform leverage, inherited improvements, and wide downstream impact."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement","description":"How strongly the letter frames security engineering as helping other engineers work more safely and effectively.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frames security mainly as isolated technical work, with no sign of helping other engineers succeed."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at supporting other teams, but the service orientation is weak or incidental."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes clear that the applicant values tooling that helps other teams or reduces busywork."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly frames security tooling as making the secure path easier for developers and reducing heroic manual effort."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows a strong service mindset by portraying security work as proactive developer enablement rather than policing or after-the-fact review."}]},{"name":"Specificity","description":"The level of concrete, role-relevant detail the letter uses to support its claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on generic claims and broad adjectives, with little concrete evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few specifics, but most qualifications are still presented as unsupported assertions."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides several concrete examples of tools, systems, or tasks relevant to the role."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses specific, role-relevant examples consistently, naming concrete system types, workflows, or technical problems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Packs the letter with precise, credible details that make the applicant's work easy to picture without reading like a résumé dump."}]},{"name":"Impact evidence","description":"How clearly the letter shows what changed, improved, or mattered because of the applicant's work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes activities but not what changed, improved, or mattered."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Suggests work was useful, but outcomes remain implied rather than stated."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives at least one clear result, such as saving time, removing a bottleneck, or improving a workflow."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly links work to concrete leverage or operational improvement, especially reduced manual effort, better routing, faster systems, or more reliable defaults."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes impact highly legible by showing how technical work changed team behavior, reclaimed expert time, eliminated a class of problems, or materially scaled security work."}]},{"name":"Technical ownership","description":"The degree to which the letter makes clear that the applicant personally drove meaningful design and implementation work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as passive participation, with little evidence that the applicant personally drove design or implementation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some individual contribution, but responsibility for architecture or end-to-end delivery is unclear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Uses first-person ownership language for building, redesigning, or delivering systems and tools."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Conveys clear ownership of important technical work, such as designing, implementing, operating, or maintaining systems used by others."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong end-to-end ownership across design, implementation, constraints, operation, or release, making it clear the applicant leads meaningful technical work."}]},{"name":"External security validation","description":"The strength of security-skill evidence that comes from certifications, competitive practice, or other signals outside normal job claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no external signal of security skill beyond ordinary engineering claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions light external validation, such as occasional CTF participation or a baseline security credential."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows moderate external validation, such as regular CTF practice, a recognized certification, or a stated attacker's perspective."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong external security evidence, such as OSCP, serious competitive CTF participation, or multiple reinforcing signals."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows the strongest external validation in the sample, combining demanding credentials or top-tier CTF performance with a clear offensive-security orientation."}]},{"name":"Open-source engagement","description":"The extent to which the letter shows meaningful contribution to public codebases or responsibility for open-source maintenance.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of open-source contribution."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions minor or occasional interaction with open source, with little detail on contribution depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes submitting patches or fixes to upstream projects that the applicant uses."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows ongoing contribution to open-source software through repeated patches, regular releases, or meaningful community interaction."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial open-source responsibility, such as maintaining a project or library with external users, handling reviews, releases, and project direction."}]},{"name":"Personal project ambition","description":"The technical difficulty and sustained initiative of self-directed projects described outside the applicant's main job.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions no personal project work outside the main job."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions only small or lightly described side projects with limited technical challenge."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes a concrete personal project that demonstrates initiative and some engineering breadth."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a substantial side project with notable systems complexity, such as distributed state, recovery, compaction, or fault tolerance."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional off-hours technical ambition through a demanding systems project that clearly required sustained design and implementation effort."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"The degree to which the letter is free of distracting spelling, grammar, and typographical issues.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling, grammar, or typographical errors that noticeably distract from the content."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several visible errors or awkward phrasings that reduce professionalism but do not block understanding."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has occasional minor errors, with overall meaning still clear and professional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is clean and professional with only rare, easy-to-ignore issues."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is polished and virtually error-free, with spelling, grammar, and punctuation consistently under control."}]},{"name":"Structural coherence","description":"The clarity and flow with which the letter builds its case from background to fit to supporting evidence.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Feels disjointed or hard to follow, with abrupt shifts or fragmentary presentation that obscures the applicant's case."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a recognizable structure, but ideas are unevenly sequenced or stitched together awkwardly."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Follows a clear structure and remains readable, though transitions or emphasis could be stronger."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Builds a coherent case with logical flow from background to fit to supporting evidence."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Reads as a well-composed argument, with strong sequencing, smooth transitions, and a memorable through-line."}]}]}
